specificFindings: Actual local PDF SHA256 reverified after the run crossed into2026-10-26 Asia/Shanghai; matches frozen targets and book.
Jobs orchard work and India age19/seven-month search are not confused with garage, Caltech or later business phases. No drug or illness instructions are added to the source account.

Did gain confirms a new perspective, not success at every original goal. The intuition comparison is a retrospective personal reflection, not a measured population ranking or denial of villagers ability to think.
Both intellect and intuition are retained, and the acquisition concerns a Lucasfilm division rather than whole company or completed Toy Story.
Product-date question locates2007 iPhone within the book sequence without converting every historical detail into new independently verified product information.
Actual page uses Bower then Bowers; raw spellings retained and explained, not silently normalised or treated as two people.
What was I like asks personal characteristics, not preferences. That refers to journey-is-reward, and I really did ellipsis refers to learning along the way.
Transition from outward accomplishment to ordinary life is not limited to fame or a new fictional sample.
Joy family timeline keeps1949 marriage,1994 husband death and two adult children a decade later distinct. Brad age34 is not grandmother age85 or estrangement10years.
Estrangement and recently resumed contact preserve sequence. Much less strengthens a negative list, not a comparative beauty rating.
Park activity/location matches are retained. The age-record wording remains the book historical account, not a live record verification.
Joy far-from-rich assessment is earlier routine, not an all-future verdict or diagnosis; In her own words marks quoted voice.
Miraculous and enjoyed every minute are personal evaluative expressions, not supernatural proof, minute-by-minute measurements or universal travel guarantees.

Taxi route preserves hotel-to-airport direction and2022 date. Call her Linda establishes narrative naming without confirming or disproving legal name. Driver county work and retirement are prior history, not Apple HR role.

All14 unique inherited parent-passage English/Chinese pairs were read; numbers, named roles, time scope and quoted voices retained. Existing translation explicitly preserves book product years and Bower/Bowers forms.
